description:
Job Description 
 
 Every day, our teams help shape the future of finance. We collaborate, innovate, and solve complex challenges together. We foster an environment where every voice is valued, fresh ideas are encouraged, and people can do their best work. And we celebrate our success as one team. If you want to make an impact in fintech, we'd like to know: Are you FIS? 
 
 Join the 2027 FIS University Program! 
 
 As a full-time employee in the FIS University Program, you will have the opportunity to participate in team projects, community service activities, professional development seminars and work with a team that is invested in your growth, development, and success. 
 
 This two-year full-time program begins 2027 with a series of AI-Enabled Learning Sprints designed to help you accelerate your impact from day one. Through this immersive experience, you will: 
 
 Learn how to leverage AI alongside human judgment to solve real business challenges and create value in your role. 

 Explore the financial technology industry, gain insight into FIS's business, and understand how innovation is shaping the future of fintech. 

 Engage directly with senior leaders and industry experts to learn about their career journeys, leadership philosophies, and perspectives on the future of work. 

 Build practical AI-enabled tools, including a personal prompt library and role-specific use cases that you can immediately apply in your daily work. 

 
 About the team: 
 We are building the next generation of software engineers, from the ground up. Our engineers will help shape how we build software, the tools and AI capabilities we use, and the engineering culture that drives innovation across FIS. As an early-career professional , you'll work alongside experienced technologists to solve complex problems, build scalable systems, and create products that serve clients around the globe. 
 
 What you will be doing: 
 
 Develop full‑stack software solutions across modern web, cloud, and data platforms 

 Apply AI and machine learning concepts to real business problems 

 Work across the entire software development lifecycle: design, build, test, deploy, and improve 

 Collaborate with product, design, and engineering peers in agile environments 

 Contribute to modern engineering practices, automation, and scalability from day one 

 
 What You Bring: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in relevant field of study including but not limited to Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence 

 Basic proficiency with AI-enabled tools and the ability to apply them effectively to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making. 

 Fluent in English; Strong written and verbal communication skills 

 Adaptability, a drive to learn, and strong problem-solving skills 

 Ability to work well independently and within a team 

 
 What We Offer You: 
 
 Competitive salary and excellent benefits 

 The chance to work on some of the most challenging, relevant issues in financial services & technology 

 A broad range of professional education and personal development possibilities – FIS is your final career step! 

 Time to support charities and give back to your community 

 A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect 

 
 *Current and future sponsorship are not available for this position* 
 # FISU202 7 
 


 Privacy Statement 
 
 FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice .
 
 EEOC Statement 
 
 FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here 
 
 For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis. 
 
 Sourcing Model 
 
 Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
